intl.title: SRU - International Admissions (undergraduate requirements, dates and deadlines)

matrix.title: SRU - International student estimated cost of attendance 2026-2027 (PDF)

test_policy.notes: SRU is test optional through 2028: ACT/SAT scores are not required, but students may submit them. Students applying to a LECOM pre-professional advising area must submit SAT or ACT scores to LECOM. Students with a 3.25 or higher cumulative core-course GPA are automatically admitted.

requirements.notes: International freshmen apply on SRU's online application ($30, non-refundable), then submit official English-translated secondary records (subjects and marks, certificates, exam results), TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo (or other listed proof) if not a native English speaker, and a passport photo-page copy. Financial verification is required for the I-20/DS-2019 but is not used to judge admission. Not approved for F-1/J-1 (SEVP): Nursing BSN, Nursing 1+2+1, RN to BSN, Aviation, Construction Management, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Commercial Music. First-year students are required to live on campus. The domestic first-year page says students with a 3.25+ core GPA are automatically admitted and others are reviewed individually (possible waitlist). No essay or recommendation is listed.

deadlines.label: International fall admission date (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The international admissions page lists 'Fall Admission: May 1' (spring: Oct. 1) without a year, so fall 2027 is assumed. The catalog says first-year students are admitted on a rolling basis for all terms and should apply early. Admission offers not confirmed with a deposit may be rescinded after May 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: All non-native speakers of English must submit an official score report. The page directs exemption questions to international.admissions@sru.edu; the transfer and post-baccalaureate sections say the requirement may be waived with a C or better in College Writing (or equivalent) from a regionally accredited U.S. institution. Also accepted: ELS Schools score report of 112 or higher, or STEP Eiken Grade 2A. The page describes no ESL or conditional-admission pathway.

english.notes: Also accepts 500 on the paper test or 173 on the computer-based test. SRU TOEFL code 2658.
The page says 'New TOEFL iBT minimum score 4.0 or higher'; it does not name the 1-6 scale.
Only scores of 95 and above are accepted.

cost.notes: International cost matrix 2026-27 (bachelor's degree, 15 credits, average on-campus room and meals): tuition $12,504 (SRU gives international students a reduced out-of-state rate, about $3,996 below the full non-Pennsylvania rate of $16,500; the international page says about $3,500), fees $3,271, room and meal $10,900, enrollment deposit $90, books $800, personal $1,700 = $29,265; the $1,500 Provost Scholarship brings the I-20 financial verification amount to $27,765. The 2027-28 estimate is $26,934

aid.notes: International students are not eligible for Title IV funds. All new undergraduate international students receive a non-need-based tuition reduction (about $3,500 per the international page, about $3,996 per the cost matrix) and the $1,500 Provost Scholarship for Global Diversity & Academic Achievement is awarded on admission with no extra application (renewal needs a 3.0 GPA; the reduced tuition needs a 2.5 GPA). A $500 Presidential Award follows after the first year or semester with a 3.5 cumulative GPA. Need-based institutional aid for internationals is not described.

majors.notes: Competitive and space-limited; BSN needs a 3.7 GPA (Nursing 1+2+1 a 3.6) with a Nov. 1 priority date. SRU cannot issue an I-20 or DS-2019 for Nursing, so students needing a student visa cannot enroll in it.

ielts.note: No IELTS institution code is listed.

pte.note: PTE is not listed as an accepted English test on the international page.
